ideas.title: Hook the cart: up the planks on the winch
ideas.critique: After four films of the motor spinning on its own on its block, this is the first time it pulls on something, and the stall that comes from the gear and drum radius is a real choice for the player. The cart is a body on one ramp along one axis, so it can turn into a rig built for that one ramp. The cheering friends add nothing; the stall has to be the point.

ideas.title: The pots run down
ideas.critique: Taking the colour from the actual Cu2+ count and limiting the current by diffusion is honest electrochemistry, and it is the road's step 1, the one everything else waits on. Watched, though, it is the same six pots getting a little paler, and resting or stirring them is housekeeping, not a toy.

ideas.title: Crank it backwards: the drum lights a wire
ideas.critique: The glowing wire has been on the island before; what is new is that the crank gets heavier because k*I pushes back, so the player feels Lenz's law in their hands. Unless Lumi's hands really turn the handle and the wire's resistance really changes with temperature, it comes out as the wire post again with a handle added.

ideas.title: A pulley block on the log
ideas.nearest: A copper wire keeps its bends
ideas.critique: A capstan-friction sheave in a general rope solver is a real tool, and letting the player choose where the stake goes is a real choice. A pulley that doubles the pull is still the most predictable thing in the whole round.

ideas.title: Tug of war with Pickles
ideas.critique: A creature pushing real force from its foot friction into the motor is funny, and it is rare on this island. The risk is that it shrinks to the 'friend reacts' payoff, with a typed-in pull number dressed up as leaning, and it only plays around the cart instead of building it.

ideas.title: Haul before dark (a mini game on the motor)
ideas.critique: Scoring a game by coil heating and ion recovery has real depth to master, which none of the island's mini games have. It rests on solvers that do not exist yet, and a HUD with a timer is a plain way to put it in front of anyone.

ideas.title: Lead plates in vinegar
ideas.critique: Planté forming, with gas per coulomb and a capacity that grows each cycle, is the cart's actual battery, and the bubbles finally give an electrical post something that moves. As pitched, though, the jar mostly fizzes while you watch, and 'deepening porous layer' is easy to fake with one number fitted to the result.

ideas.title: Hear the stall coming
ideas.nearest: Chipping a stone to change its note
ideas.critique: Sound made from the commutator rate and the spark energy is something the island has never had for a machine, and hearing the load in the pitch is the sharpest idea in the round. It adds nothing to the cart itself, and if the clicks are a sample whose pitch is shifted, it falls to a look.

ideas.title: Grease the axle
ideas.nearest: A copper wire keeps its bends
ideas.critique: Two friction coefficients typed in and a key that switches between them is a chore loop with a dark sheen on the shaft. There is nothing here to watch twice.

ideas.title: Set the brushes by hand
ideas.critique: A neutral plane that moves with load, taken from the Ferrite solve, is real physics, but the film would be yet another close shot of the sparking commutator, the fifth on this motor. A brush angle that changes with load is subtle enough that the player may never notice it.
